entry.title: New: dsh-bull-bear
entry.summary: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving. Exact install spec: github:potoior/dsh-bull-bear. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
